acceptance: The document matches observed behaviour, with the evidence linked.
`make pr-arm` reports a stale cancelled hold run by name and either reruns it or prints the exact command (test with a recorded API fixture).
description:
## Problem
docs/agent/merge-authority.md says a superseded cancelled run does not block (state UNSTABLE). On PR #4528 (2026-11-25) a stale cancelled `hold` run kept the PR BLOCKED with every check green until `gh run rerun 45700727976`.

## Change
Reproduce or explain the behaviour from the ruleset and check-run API (`commits/<sha>/check-runs?filter=latest`); then either fix the hold workflow so a cancelled run is superseded, or correct the document and teach `make pr-arm` to detect and rerun it.

## Decision gates
- Rerunning a `hold` run is allowed only when no `no-auto-merge` label is present; never bypass a real hold.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, make agent-write-preflight); the primary clone is read-only.
- Heavy work only through make heavy-run; never bypass or signal the lock, and never kill processes by name pattern (pkill -f); stop only PIDs you started.
- Commits as the configured human identity; no agent attribution.
- No carried or own reimplementation of upstream code without the owner decision recorded in datagen-decision-upstream-gap-policy.
- A choice between a small and a large implementation path goes to the owner with sizes before work starts.
- Report only results that were observed; name anything not run.
